PROFILE
Front office leader with 10 years in 4- and 5-star hotels in Singapore, the last four

15 across reception, concierge, guest relations and the night desk, and I am an
experienced Opera PMS super-user (Opera V5 and Opera Cloud). Known for calm handling
of VIP and complaint situations, structured training, and turning the front desk into
a revenue contributor through upselling and early check-in packages.
